_about: Mechs, variants and loadouts: one entry each. "parts" places parts from parts.json on the chassis (metres in the body frame: +x right, +y up, -z forward). "legs" gives each leg its hip mount and the parts and actuators it is built from; leg parts are placed by the leg solver at the rest stance, so the mass sums see where they really hang. A variant is "inherits": "<mech>" plus only what differs (deep-merged, so a loadout override keeps the other slots). "status": "planned" entries are waiting on a lane and are skipped by the game and the mass tests. "controller" picks the locomotion script.

standin.label: Stand-in walker
standin.description: Lane A1's box walker: same data path as the real Juggernaut (per-part colliders, mass summed from parts, actuators per joint) so the game loop runs end to end before lane B1's export lands.

juggernaut_m2.label: Juggernaut (Model 2)
juggernaut_m2.description: The Reginleif-style walker from lane B1's export: parts, colliders, sockets and actuators arrive with it.

juggernaut_m2_blades.label: Juggernaut (Model 2, blades)
juggernaut_m2_blades.description: Close-combat variant: high-frequency blades on the sub-arms (lane A5).
